primitiveName: Existing signed-in route, header, and layout ownership
whyFits: ThetaFrame already owns auth-gated routing, the signed-in shell, permission-aware navigation, and the current /dashboard landing contract.
adaptationPlan: Add /console beside /dashboard, reuse the existing auth and shell boundaries, and register Console in navigation without changing the shipped landing path yet.

primitiveName: Desktop-first layout map and premium panel zoning
whyFits: This is the strongest external source for hero-first zoning, support-card rhythm, and shell structure, even though its final scan behavior must be changed for ThetaFrame.
adaptationPlan: Translate the layout map into ThetaFrame width and aspect classes, reuse its panel rhythm, and replace the fixed dashboard scan path with a center-weighted Console layout engine.

primitiveName: Control Center hero plus primary action island
whyFits: The current dashboard already frames one clear next action, review-first AI, and calm lane orientation without becoming a KPI wall.
adaptationPlan: Extract a Console-specific Now Frame from the dashboard hero, mood state, and start-today composition while keeping heavy editing inside /daily.

primitiveName: Compact status cards and support rail
whyFits: ThetaFrame already has compact card language for AI, calendar, and mobile state plus dashboard review counts and support-rail composition.
adaptationPlan: Condense these cards into a single system-health band with chips, small counters, and collapsible detail rather than rendering them as equal-weight dashboard panels.

primitiveName: Week Canvas, theme island, Goals Canvas, and next-step surfaces
whyFits: Weekly and Vision already expose the right kind of orientation primitives: low-clutter theme, protected steps, one goal, and one next step.
adaptationPlan: Summarize these lane surfaces into Week Vector and Continuity support modules without embedding the full editors inside Console.

primitiveName: Life Ledger due-soon, next-90-days, and reminder surfaces
whyFits: Life Ledger already models due-soon execution groups, next due dates, reminder queues, and dated events with truthful current-state language.
adaptationPlan: Create a summarized horizon module that pulls due-soon and reminder state into Console while preserving full execution and editing inside Life Ledger.

whyFits: HabitCanvasMap already expresses calm lane progression and the current header already encodes which routes are allowed for each user.
adaptationPlan: Turn HabitCanvasMap into a lane atlas with optional-lane states and phone bottom-sheet or ribbon behavior, then reconcile it with current nav permissions.

primitiveName: Dashboard brain-dump review batch and AI draft canvas block
whyFits: This is the strongest local pattern for grouped review-first draft objects with clear lane previews and approve or reject or apply actions.
adaptationPlan: Re-skin the existing batch cards as an Assistant Review queue with provenance and review-state chips while keeping transcript-first chat out of the home shell.

primitiveName: Permission- and data-driven dashboard section gating
whyFits: The current dashboard already conditionally renders Life Ledger, FollowUps, REACH, Admin, and review surfaces based on access and availability.
adaptationPlan: Extract the section gating into a Console module registry that collapses empty modules completely instead of reserving dead space.

primitiveName: Distance-aware density and presentation mode policy
whyFits: No scanned repo implements near or mid or far operator modes, density reduction by viewing distance, or display-specific module suppression for an operational shell.
adaptationPlan: Build a Console-specific display-mode system from the Executive Console contract, borrowing only reduced-motion semantics from Speakly as a secondary idea.

whyFits: This donor is visually strong but scans like a desktop operator dashboard rather than a center-weighted 21:9 reading surface.
adaptationPlan: Build a new 21:9 center-content band from the Console contract and keep any reused token work separate from the rejected scan pattern.
rejectReason: The fixed rail and full-width reading path violate the 21:9 Console rule that text and primary action stay inside a controlled center band.

whyFits: No scanned donor supports orbit-only secondary zones or center-cluster action placement for 32:9 surfaces.
adaptationPlan: Build a net-new center-cluster plus orbit-edge composition directly from the Console contract instead of stretching any existing desktop shell.
rejectReason: Existing dashboard grids force edge scanning and do not support secondary-orbit-only placement, which breaks the 32:9 Console rule.

primitiveName: Premium dark operator tokens plus restrained ambient motion references
whyFits: The strategy dashboard provides the best dark premium token base, ThetaFrame already carries lane-aware atmosphere, and Speakly offers a useful reduced-motion atmospheric reference.
adaptationPlan: Rebase external tokens into ThetaFrame's midnight field and phi-blue or teal or gold rules, keep atmosphere secondary to work, and limit motion to sparse state-supporting transitions.

primitiveName: Existing authenticated multi-role browser QA harness
whyFits: ThetaFrame already has deterministic route QA, signed-in state capture, role-aware checks, and screenshot evidence capture wired to current test IDs.
adaptationPlan: Extend the existing harness later with /console route coverage and the P0 display matrix rather than inventing a second screenshot system.

primitiveName: Repo-native console planning and reuse-inventory workflow
whyFits: The current execution plan and console contract now define the authoritative handoff structure for future Console implementation slices.
adaptationPlan: Reuse this inventory, matrix, and receipt as the baseline reference until a proof-backed /console implementation supersedes them.
